title: scirpus palustris subsp. uniglumis
intro: Scirpus palustris subsp. uniglumis, commonly known as woolly club rush or wool grass, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the sedge family (Cyperaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and protect against infections. The therapeutic actions of Scirpus palustris subsp. uniglumis include its ability to act as a demulcent, mucilages, and expectorant, making it useful in treating respiratory issues, wounds, and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
